modes.payload-first: Prefer Payload fetches and fall back to local data when Payload is unavailable.
modes.fallback-local: Keep local data as the primary source while migration work is still incomplete.
modes.payload-only: Disable local fallback and fail fast if Payload data is missing or unavailable.
